dietary_preferences.notes: Needs less spicy food and often prefers mild sides.

cook.name: Cook
cook.literacy: limited — can access WhatsApp links but may not read text reliably

roti_config.note: On full-roti days, make 5 extra rotis for the higher-appetite household member

repetition_avoidance.note: Don't repeat the same main dish within 3 days. Try not to do the same cuisine type 3 days in a row.

kid_general_rules: Reduce spice level significantly — kid has low spice tolerance
For sambar/rasam: set aside plain cooked dal before mixing with masala paste
For eggs: no chili in the kid's omelette or scrambled eggs
For North Indian curries: keep a portion with less chili powder
For Indo-Chinese: keep a portion aside before adding chili sauce

grocery.ordering_pattern: currently ad-hoc/daily — goal is to reduce this with better planning
grocery.note: The plan should catch missing ingredients the night before instead of during the morning cook.
